title: Freelance Tester (Faroe Islands) – Global Payment Research ($100/hr)
description: We’re Testlio , a global software testing company that helps businesses make sure their apps, websites, and digital services work correctly for real people around the world. We’re currently looking for someone based in the Faroe Islands to help us test an international payment service. What are we testing? When companies send money internationally, they need to make sure the payment reaches the right type of local bank account and that important information, such as the amount, date, and payment reference, appears correctly. That’s where you come in. Our client will send a small test payment to your local Faroe Islands bank account . Your role is simply to: Receive the international transfer. Check the amount, date, and payment reference. Take screenshots and/or a short video confirming the payment arrived. Share the requested evidence with our testing team. You will not send money, make a purchase, transfer money back, or use your own funds. The purpose is simply to confirm that an international payment reaches a real Faroe Island bank account correctly. Requirements Currently based in Faroe Island . Have a local Faroe Island bank account in local currency . Comfortable providing the banking details needed to receive the transfer. Comfortable providing screenshots/video as evidence. Willing to sign a consent form before your information is shared with the payment provider. No specific device is required, and we’ll provide instructions for the task. Time & Payment The active testing takes approximately 1 hour total . The bank transfer itself may take up to 2 business days to arrive. $18 USD/hour $100 USD completion bonus after successfully completing the testing requirements How To Test This You will be asked to create an account on our website in order to access the testing materials and track any issues with the app/payment transfer. This stage takes approximately 30 minutes, and can later be used to find additional freelancer work on our website. Interested? Apply through this posting and answer a few short eligibility questions. If you meet the requirements, our team will contact you with the next steps. #LI-REMOTE

title: Software Test Engineer
description: Overview Join our dynamic team as a Software Test Engineer and become a vital driver of quality assurance excellence! In this role, you will lead the testing efforts for innovative software solutions, ensuring they meet the highest standards of performance, reliability, and user satisfaction. Your expertise will help shape seamless user experiences across diverse platforms and technologies. Be part of a forward-thinking environment where your skills in test automation, system testing, and continuous integration will propel projects from development to successful release with precision and confidence. Duties Develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts to validate software functionality across various applications and platforms. Implement and manage test automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, TestNG, Cucumber, and Jenkins to streamline testing processes and improve efficiency. Conduct functional, system, integration, performance (using LoadRunner), and user acceptance testing to verify software meets business requirements. Perform root cause analysis on defects to identify underlying issues and collaborate with development teams to resolve bugs swiftly. Utilize SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) best practices to ensure quality is integrated throughout the project lifecycle. Support release management by verifying software builds, conducting regression testing, and ensuring smooth deployment processes. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including developers, business analysts, and DevOps engineers to optimize testing strategies within Agile (Scrum) or Waterfall methodologies. Use tools like Jira, GitHub, GitLab, TFS (Team Foundation Server), SVN (Subversion), and Azure DevOps for tracking issues, version control, and continuous integration workflows. Analyze data from tests to identify performance bottlenecks or system vulnerabilities; leverage knowledge of APIs (Application Programming Interfaces), RESTful services, SOAP web services, SQL/PL-SQL databases (MySQL, Oracle), and cloud platforms like AWS or Azure for comprehensive testing coverage. Provide technical support during testing phases by troubleshooting software issues on Windows, Linux, Android, iOS environments using Visual Studio, Eclipse, or other IDEs. Qualifications Proven experience in software testing with a strong understanding of SDLC methodologies including Agile (Scrum) and Waterfall models. Hands-on expertise with test automation tools such as Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, TestNG, JUnit, and scripting languages like Python or JavaScript. Solid knowledge of performance testing tools such as LoadRunner or similar solutions; experience with system testing and load/stress testing is highly desirable. Familiarity with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using Jenkins or GitLab CI/CD for automated build verification.

In addition to an exciting project and dynamic working environment, the role offers long-term development prospects as the team grows. Responsibilities -Review business requirements -Write test cases for new work with a focus on quality and efficiency -Estimate test effort for planned work -Execute, automate and manage test cases Required skills/knowledge -Test automation (Cypress & JavaScript) -Proven ability to translate functional requirements into clear test cases -Strong knowledge of API testing concepts, tools and frameworks, such as Postman, SoapUI and JMeter -Ability to create a clear and accurate bug report -Collaborative with great teamwork skills Desirable skills/knowledge -Working knowledge of BDD -Agile/Scrum methodology -Experience with performance and load testing of APIs -Azure platform -FX products -Inter-bank payment systems -Knowledge of SQL Benefits -Private health insurance -Flexible hours -Fully remote -25 days holiday plus UK bank holidays -Employee referral programme -Professional development/training budget -Occasional business trips to our Barcelona office How to apply If you are interested in this position, please email hr@neoftl.com. title: Lead QA Auditor/Case Manager
description: Case Manager / Lead QA Auditor (S4) – UK based We are on the front line of recruitment, enabling organizations to hire smarter and onboard faster. At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do—from our customers and partners to our greatest advantage: our team members. Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands. About First Advantage First Advantage (NASDAQ: FA) is a leading provider of global software and data in the HR technology industry. Enabled by proprietary technology and AI, First Advantage’s platforms, data, and APIs power comprehensive employment background screening, identity solutions, and verification services. Headquartered in Atlanta, GA, we have an internationally distributed workforce of about 10,000 employees spanning 17 countries. With a strong emphasis on innovation, automation, and customer success, First Advantage empowers 80,000 organizations to modernize their hiring and onboarding processes on a global scale. What you’ll do The Case Manager will be responsible for ensuring that client orders are completed in line with their screening program criteria from start to end. The primary responsibility will be to review cases at pre-process, QC (post-process) and after the post-process review stage to identify and resolve any quality issues with the data provided by the applicant or that obtained by First Advantage. It involves a keen attention to detail and full QC on the end-to-end process starting with information received from the applicant, all the way to signing off all information received before it is shared with the Client. Through this, the case manager aims to deliver the highest level of quality for the Client, and provide them with the comfort they can make sound hiring decisions with a comprehensive final report they can trust. Responsibilities Conduct pre-process and post-process review using the (Client-specific) checklist and Client SOP as a guide; ensuring that all mandatory pieces of information and documentation are present before fulfilment of the case begins, and after fulfilment has been completed. Complete search level data entry on behalf of the Client by adding searches to cases as needed. Conduct a holistic review of all searches completed within a case to ensure that all required searches were carried out using the correct details and were completed accurately and according to client requirements. Serve as the senior quality subject matter expert for complex, high-risk and escalated cases, providing guidance and ensuring compliance with client requirements, quality standards and operational procedures. Review and provide guidance on exceptions where standard operating procedures cannot be followed, ensuring client-specific requirements, compliance obligations and associated risks are appropriately considered and documented.

As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds. As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised. What You Can Expect As a Principal Test Engineer - AI you would be a senior member of the Software Applications Development Team responsible for defining the quality strategy, validation approach, and test architecture for Zimmer Biomet’s mymobility product, including its AI-enabled software capabilities and intelligent features. This job provides technical leadership for testing intelligent software, data-driven workflows, and integrated platform components to help ensure the product is reliable, secure, and fit for global deployment. You would be expected to bring strong technical judgment, a risk-based mindset, and deep software quality experience to evolving areas of AI-enabled product development. This role also helps shape automation strategy, mentors other test engineers, and influences engineering practices to improve testability, observability, and overall product quality across the software development lifecycle How You'll Create Impact Lead and evolve the test strategy for the mymobility product, with particular focus on AI-enabled features, integrated workflows, and other high-risk product areas. Define practical, risk-based validation approaches for AI-related functionality, including model-driven or data-driven features, supporting services, and end-to-end workflows. Partner with software engineering, data science, product, quality, and other cross-functional teams to improve test coverage, investigate defects, and support high-quality global releases. Drive the continued development of automation, regression, integration, and data validation practices that support efficient and scalable quality engineering. Contribute to validation documentation, defect analysis, metrics, and release readiness activities in support of product quality, compliance expectations, and continuous improvement. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other engineers while helping strengthen quality practices across the broader development organisation. Stay current with emerging approaches, tools, and industry practices relevant to AI/ML quality engineering, and drive adoption of appropriate methods where they improve effectiveness or assurance.

title: Cyber Security Controls Tester (Contractor)
description: Contract Type: Contract Contract Length: Immediate start until February 2027 Security Clearance: Active SC Clearance required and must be verifiable About the Opportunity We are seeking an experienced Cyber Security Controls Tester to support a large-scale security assurance programme within a highly regulated environment. This is an excellent opportunity for a contractor with a strong background in security controls testing, assurance and risk management, particularly within central government or wider public sector environments. Working remotely alongside security architects, risk teams and technical stakeholders, you will provide independent assurance over security controls, helping to ensure that controls are appropriately designed, implemented and operating effectively in line with recognised security standards and frameworks. What You'll Be Doing Evaluating the effectiveness of security controls within the identified environment to ensure they meet the standards defined within supporting documentation, including High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and Controls Catalogues. Testing controls against recognised security frameworks and standards, including ISO 27001, NIST CSF and NIST 800-53. Reviewing policies, procedures, network configurations, firewall rules, identity and access management controls, and other technical and procedural security controls. Applying recognised controls testing methodologies, including documentation reviews, walkthroughs, sampling and technical verification activities. Agreeing testing scope and plans with stakeholders, risk teams and security architects to ensure assurance activity addresses key security concerns. Assessing both the design effectiveness and operating effectiveness of implemented security controls. Providing pragmatic remediation guidance and recommendations to address identified control weaknesses. Supporting improvements to policies, processes and security controls to strengthen the overall security posture of services and environments. Maintaining clear documentation of testing activities, evidence collected, findings and remediation recommendations. Producing comprehensive assurance reports outlining security posture, findings, risks and recommendations. Presenting findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders and agreeing remediation actions where required. Working closely with risk and security architecture teams to ensure controls testing supports wider risk management and assurance objectives. What We're Looking For You will be a detail-oriented cyber security professional with experience assessing and validating security controls across complex technical environments. You'll be comfortable engaging with both technical and business stakeholders and have the ability to provide clear, evidence-based assurance and practical recommendations.

Ensure best practices in system development ranging from test coverage, use of enterprise standards, adherence to target architecture, high-availability and scalability, low latency, and fault-tolerance, thus ensuring delivery of high-quality systems. Create detailed documentation on systems as well as processes ranging from checklists for onboarding new hires, comprehensive overview of systems, runbooks for developing, monitoring and troubleshooting system issues and recommendations on future improvements. Own solution design discussions and meetings to ensure systems are aligned in the bigger scheme of things.

Now is an exciting time to join the team and make a real difference as well as showcase your design and architecture skills as we shape the next generation of data in ticketing with intelligent profile, AI initiatives, integration with various components of the TM ecosystem, and overall, building a world-class system. If you are the sort of person that enjoys a fast-paced work environment, is able to quickly pick-up cutting-edge technologies and product concepts, and has the desire to experiment with and evaluate new technological paths forward, this is the role for you. WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING Design and develop new systems and implement enhancements to existing systems, breaking down complex problems into essential components and building efficient solutions. Work with product teams to understand large units of development and the impact on the teams specifically to identify areas of reuse across the teams to eliminate wasteful development. Own and evolve technical strategy and architectural direction across all three teams. Review existing infrastructure and work with the teams to enhance and refactor to modern architectures again focusing on resuse and simplification, develop and design high-traffic, large scale software applications and data flow processes, infrastructure for deploying and long-term maintenance of the systems. Design and develop peripheral systems and processes - monitoring and alerting services, automated build and deployment pipelines, systems for gathering application performance metrics, ensuring efficiency in cost. Push best practices in system development ranging from test coverage, use of enterprise standards, adherence to target architecture, high-availability and scalability, low latency, and fault-tolerance, thus ensuring delivery of high-quality systems. Establish shared engineering standards, patterns, and guardrails, and ensure their consistent adoption across the wider function. Identify systemic technical risks and dependencies that span multiple products or teams, and lead their resolution. Work with the teams to design and build a comprehensive QA platform/solution to ensure quality and speed of delivery.

title: Quality Assurance Manager, International
description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role We are hiring for our first dedicated international quality hire at Grüns. You'll own the quality system for every market outside the US: product release, specifications, complaints and adverse events, incident management, contract manufacturer oversight, stability, and transit qualification. For products sold in the EU, you'll build and run the Quality Management System processes that keep us compliant with EU and local market requirements across the product lifecycle. Today these responsibilities sit informally with the US QA team. The job is to figure out where they should live, build the processes, and then run them. You'll work across Regulatory, Supply Chain, Operations, and our external manufacturing and 3PL partners, and you'll be the escalation point when something goes wrong in an international market. Location: While this role is part of our global remote HQ, we feel a candidate based in or around Germany or the United Kingdom will be most successful in this role. The team members you'll be working with most are in multiple countries and time zones, so we ask that you are comfortable working a way that allows for some overlap in working hours to collaborate. More generally, we operate in a fully remote, high trust environment with teammates across multiple countries and time zones. While we work async by default, we come together in person twice a year for offsites that help us connect, align, and build real relationships IRL. In this role, you will: Release finished products only after verifying specs, COAs, manufacturing docs, deviations, and market-specific requirements Own consumer complaint intake and triage across level 1, 2, and 3 Build and run traceability, recall/withdrawal, mock recall, complaint, adverse-event, and food safety incident processes for EU products Own supplier and contract manufacturer qualification: Quality Agreements, audits, CAPAs/SCARs, deviations, change controls, investigations, ongoing performance monitoring Run BMT testing and oversee microbiological, chemical, allergen, contaminant, nutritional, and stability testing, including OOS/OOT investigations and third-party labs Assess quality and regulatory risk on any formulation, ingredient, supplier, process, spec, packaging, or labeling change before it ships.
